draft_elevation.note: RECONSTRUCTED by the draft rules, family row 'service' overlaid with the frontage row: A background house with no named record and no register row: the brick family's hip over the sheet's printed storeys, every face closed, nothing read beyond the sheet. 3B, the row's south end behind its stone strip; the one-storey store built forward to the street line is a 1911 shop whose 1904 state is not read, so it is kept out of the draft (`keep_out`: its band 0-4.7 m from the street line, short of the stone strip). Its two-storey brick shed at the rear stands as its own building. Heights are the rules' starting values inside RECONSTRUCTION-RULES.md's ranges; bays, entrance side, chimneys and dormers are counts the family rules choose, and the seed 572086133 only tints the fabric inside +-6 %.
